pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-pointed polygonal regions with highly serrated or leaf-like edge gradients; dark regions occupy significantly more spatial area than the light background.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of thin, light-colored pathways forming a grid-like topology with numerous three-way and four-way junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane with a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background along the upper neck and shoulder line.
